text:
Maria Chen: Hey finance — my expense is stuck in Concur, got flagged. Merchant on the card shows 'XYZ Markets' but the folio is 'Hotel Solace SFO'. I stayed there for a client meeting (booking HTL-9087). I submitted it as a personal card expense earlier today. Attached booking confirmation + folio: <https://drive.redwood.com/receipts/HTL-9087-folio.pdf>

Jon Patel: Can you confirm whether this was paid on personal or corpcard? Merchant mismatch is usually the cause.

Maria Chen: Personal card. I also attached a snippet of my card statement showing the charge (last 4: 4321): <https://drive.redwood.com/statements/maria-jan-stmt.png>

Finance Bot: @Maria Chen thanks — to move this through please upload the itemized folio, proof of payment (bank/statement), and a manager approval note. Tag @Lisa Gomez for approval. Use memo code EXP-INV-ADJ when you submit. See: https://redwood.help/expenses/merchant-mismatch for docs.

Maria Chen: Uploaded the folio + bank snippet to the expense. @Lisa Gomez can you sign off? Also: the folio shows "city occupancy tax" — is that VAT reclaimable? This was a US hotel.

Lisa Gomez: I can approve — confirmed this was a client dinner + overnight for on-site kickoff. Approving reimbursement. :white_check_mark:

Jon Patel: Finance note — US lodging taxes aren't VAT reclaimable. Reimburse the full gross amount. If Finance needs the vendor's TIN for accounting, we can request it, but not required for employee reimbursement.

Finance Bot: Request recorded. Ticket #FIN-4219 created for this merchant-mismatch exception. Reimbursement approved pending upload of the statement (seen) and manager sign-off (received). Expected payment: next payroll cycle. :tada:

Maria Chen: Thanks all — saved everything to the client folder and updated expense code to EXP-CLIENT-SFO.

Finance Bot: Closing thread: reimbursed gross $412.57 on payroll cycle 2024-11-15. If you want tax/VAT breakdowns in future, request an itemized tax line from the hotel folio at checkout.
